digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate material basis and fingerprinting
propositions: Whitespace-only edits to no_file_impact_reason produce different material fingerprints and stale attestations, violating the documented invariant that insignificant whitespace should not invalidate signed reviews
material_basis() canonicalizes the description but inserts no_file_impact_reason raw and unprocessed, causing boundary and trailing whitespace in the reason to change the fingerprint hash

The fix adds an independent normalize_reason boolean parameter (defaulting True) threaded through material_basis, material_fingerprint, and current_material_fingerprint_impl to normalize insignificant reason whitespace only in the current path

_legacy_material_ok must explicitly preserve raw-reason hashing in all three historical generations: pre-330c raw, post-330c/pre-2be7 checkbox-normalized, and post-2be7/pre-fix canonical-description/raw-reason to maintain byte-exact compatibility

Whitespace-only variants of no_file_impact_reason now produce identical current fingerprints and certified attestations, while interior whitespace and word changes remain material and produce stale-material verdicts
